verified_findings: IRNI is the canonical geography owner; Radar Worker reads through the internal IRNI_GEOGRAPHY Service Binding.
Radar Worker IRNI v2 client and neighborhood identity resolver exist and validate registry metadata, revision, checksum and exact namespaced legacy aliases.

apps/api/server.ts constructs createProductionGeospatialModule() without the required neighborhood identity resolver, trusted source resolver or approval authorization dependencies; read model must remain BLOCKED and approval fail-closed.

The geography geometry engine implements WGS84 validation, ring closure, self-intersection checks, hole containment, point-in-polygon and selected CRS transformations.
The existing NIPS V2 reference design is the authoritative neighborhood profile specification; do not duplicate it.
